The sentence "The carpenter told the onlooker that he had been working on the house for three weeks" uses the pronoun "he."  
The antecedent could logically be the carpenter (since the carpenter is the one more likely to have been working on the house), but grammatically, "he" could refer to either the carpenter or the onlooker.  
Because there is no additional context to clarify, the reference is ambiguous.  

Final answer: (C)
